headline: OAK @ SDP matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 3.77 at SDP 5.13, with a projected total of 8.90. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: OAK moved -0.87 runs while SDP moved +1.06, changing the projected margin by -1.93 runs. NRFI probability dropped -5.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Luis Medina has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nick Kurtz, Carlos Cortes, Miguel Andujar, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Lawrence Butler, Sung-Mun Song because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
